verdict.rationale: Unreal's first-party Python editor-scripting docs explicitly support building custom asset import and management pipelines and automating repetitive asset tasks such as LOD generation. That covers the pipeline-scripts core of the story. However, the evidence never documents import hooks (post-import callbacks) or reusable import presets. missing for 10: documented import hooks/callbacks on asset import, import presets/settings reuse, a concrete batch-import example, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a technical artist, asset import is automatable — import hooks, presets, and pipeline scripts process incoming assets without hand-clicking each one

citations.quote: Create your own Asset import and management pipelines
Construct larger-scale asset management pipelines or workflows that tie the Unreal Editor to other 3D applications that you use in your organization.
Automate time-consuming Asset management tasks in the Unreal Editor, like generating Levels of Detail (LODs) for Static Meshes.
Minimize or eliminate the need to repeat the same series of tasks over and over,
